notes:
Summary: Sundial runs an omnichannel contact center platform used by mid-size enterprises in finance and retail. Primary goal: reduce agent handle time and increase first-response resolution with multilingual agent assist and automated ticket summarization. Key asks:
- Real-time agent assist (typeahead + suggested replies) with <200-300ms roundtrip for interactive use.
- Accurate ticket summarization for case notes (concise, preserve verbatim customer quotes).
- Tool-calling: create/update tickets in Zendesk + fire webhooks into their CRM; must support idempotency and audit logs.
- Spike reliability: 10x traffic events (marketing, product incidents) — need graceful degradation and regional routing.
- Multilingual: translate inbound messages, emit locale-aware tone variants (formal vs conversational per region).
- Data controls: must keep EU customer content in EU region; keys in KMS; full audit trail.
Notes from call: "They liked the hosts vs dedicated slide — want dedicated pools for EU and NA with a private control plane."
Open questions: which model variants will we route to on fallback? What are default token limits on streamed responses? POC metrics: latency p95, summary ROUGE/qual score vs human, translation fidelity on domain terms.
